observation_period: 65th Congress (1917 to 1918) to the 119th Congress (2025 to 2026) to date
universe_or_base: Cloture motions filed, votes on cloture and cloture invoked, on legislation and nominations together
qualification: Counts mix bills and nominations, and the vote needed changed over time (two-thirds of those voting until 1975, then three-fifths of senators for most matters; a simple majority for nominations since 2013 and 2017). The 119th Congress is still in session

complete.description: false while the Congress is in session

printed_source_line: Source: United States Senate, Senate Action on Cloture Motions, 65th Congress (1917) to the 119th Congress to date, United States Senate. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Counts include bills and nominations; the votes needed changed in 1975, 2013 and 2017.
unconfirmed: The threshold history in the qualification comes from the Senate's rules history in general knowledge and was not read on senate.gov today; check it on the Senate's cloture page before a chart prints it
